tokens.name: color-fob-950
tokens.usage: Page ground: body background, scrollbar track, and the dark text on amber fills (primary-foreground). The deepest amber-tinted surface, never pure black.

tokens.name: color-fob-900
tokens.usage: Raised surface one step up from the ground: cards and popovers.

tokens.name: color-fob-800
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: secondary/muted/accent backgrounds, form inputs, the regular-price ticket chip.

tokens.name: color-fob-700
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers between event rows and page sections. Decorative only (1.2:1 on fob-950); never the only cue for a control's edge.

tokens.name: color-fob-600
tokens.usage: Highest surface step; defined in the theme, rarely used directly.

tokens.name: color-fob-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on every fob surface (17.5:1 on fob-950, 14.6:1 on fob-700).

tokens.name: color-fob-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary text: locations, descriptions, instrument labels, month abbreviations. 7.0:1 on fob-950, 5.8:1 on fob-700.

tokens.name: color-fob-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta (years, times, the scroll cue). Fails body contrast: 2.5:1 on fob-950. Kept exact from the source; don't use it for anything a visitor must read.

tokens.name: color-fob-gold
tokens.usage: The brand's lightest warm accent: date numerals, page titles, outline-button labels, the presale chip, hover state of event titles. 11.9:1 on fob-950.

tokens.name: color-fob-amber
tokens.usage: Core accent: the section-title rule, button borders (40% at rest, 100% on hover), 10–12% tints behind hovered controls, focus rings. 8.0:1 on fob-950.

tokens.name: color-fob-copper
tokens.usage: Deepest warm accent from the logo, closing the gold → amber → copper ramp. 4.5:1 on fob-950: body-text safe only on fob-950 itself.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: shadcn: page background. Same value as color-fob-950.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: default text on background. Same value as color-fob-text.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn: Card surface. Same value as color-fob-900.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: shadcn: popover surface.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn: solid primary button fill. Same value as color-fob-amber.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: text on primary (7.9:1). Dark ink on amber, never white.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn: secondary button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: text on secondary (16.3:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn: muted fill.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: secondary text, e.g. CardDescription (6.5:1 on muted). Same value as color-fob-subtle.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn: hover fill for ghost and outline buttons.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn: destructive action fill. With destructive-foreground it reaches 4.46:1, just under AA for small text; use it at 14px bold or larger.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn: text on destructive.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: shadcn: default border on every element (the base layer applies border-border).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: shadcn: outline-button and input border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: shadcn: focus ring (applied at 50% as the default outline). Solid amber is 8.0:1 on background.

styles.name: event-title
styles.usage: Event page h1. Fluid: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.5rem); 88px is the max. Ink color-fob-text.

styles.name: date-numeral
styles.usage: Day number in the event hero, clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem). Event cards use clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem). Always color-fob-gold.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page h1 on inner pages, clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem), in color-fob-gold.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2 (SectionTitle), clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.8rem), color-fob-text, followed 16px below by a 56px × 1px color-fob-amber rule.

styles.name: subsection-title
styles.usage: h2 inside the event page (Entradas, Horarios, Ubicación), clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 1.9rem).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Creando momentos a través de la música
styles.usage: Hero tagline and event descriptions, clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.4rem). Gloock ships one weight, so 300 renders as its 400; italic is synthesized.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Event name in EventCard, clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.3rem). Turns color-fob-gold on row hover.

styles.name: member-name
styles.usage: Musician name under the portrait in BandMemberCard.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Música en vivo para bodas, quinceaños y eventos corporativos.
styles.usage: Default body copy, set on <body>. color-fob-text or color-fob-subtle.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: ThemedButton and the hero CTA label, color-fob-gold.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting lines: event location, shadcn button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Event start time and similar meta.

styles.name: instrument-label
styles.usage: Set in UPPERCASE. Instrument under a musician's name, color-fob-subtle.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in UPPERCASE. Kicker above a block and month abbreviations in date blocks.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn base radius. Tailwind derives radius-sm (−1px), radius-lg (+2px) and radius-xl (+6px) from it with calc().

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Equal to radius: the default rounding for shadcn controls.

gradient.note: Gradients the site uses on the FOB palette. They darken or fade; none is decorative color. The old yellow → orange → red Tailwind gradients are not part of the brand.

tokens.name: gradient-hero-overlay
tokens.usage: Over the full-bleed hero photo: amber-tinted darkness, heaviest at the top and solid at the bottom so the page ground continues. Hero.astro.

tokens.name: gradient-event-overlay
tokens.usage: Over an event's cover image on the event page, lighter at the top so the photo reads, solid behind the title.

tokens.name: gradient-event-fallback
tokens.usage: Stands in for an event cover when the event has no image: a faint warm glow falling into the ground.

tokens.name: gradient-fade-start
tokens.usage: 64px edge fade on the left of the repertoire carousel, from color-fob-900 to clear.

tokens.name: gradient-fade-end
tokens.usage: The matching fade on the carousel's right edge.
